proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations establish two static u32[8] arrays with the stated values and declaration order. The correction properly withdraws compiled adjacency and section-size claims; compiled layout remains explicitly deferred.

Canonical masks select sector bits 11–13 and latency bits 8–10. The cBlock division precedes the zero-sector/minimum-block guard and its -2 assignment. CARDProbeEx can select a zero entry and report READY without that guard. Machine-level division behavior remains explicitly deferred.

CARDProbe is declared int CARDProbe(long chan), explicitly returns zero only in the suppression branch, and otherwise calls EXIProbe without an explicit return. Independently inspected snapshot polling stores and compares its result. Caller intent does not establish compiled return behavior.

contradictions.reason: The upstream consecutive 64-byte compiled-section claim exceeds source evidence. Proposal index 0 resolves this by retaining exact source types and values while deferring placement, adjacency and section size.

Guaranteed normal-path probe return semantics are unsupported by the canonical function body. Proposal index 2 preserves the declared interface and demonstrated caller intent while explicitly deferring machine return behavior.
